primaryReasoning: The upper-secondary introduction explicitly adds differential/integral methods to lower-secondary function knowledge. Its mandatory function-class list includes sine and cosine (p66), followed by the differentiation and graph-relation competencies (p67). This is positive stage evidence; exclusion is not inferred from the J10 ID/title/phase or from a missing keyword.
